verdicts.title: Graded Ehrhart Theory of Unimodular Zonotopes
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Graded Ehrhart theory is a new $q$-analogue of Ehrhart theory based on the orbit harmonics method. We study the graded Ehrhart theory of unimodular zonotopes from a matroid-theoretic perspective. Generalizing a result of Stanley (1991), we prove that the graded lattice point count of a unimodular zonotope is a $q$-evaluation of its Tutte polynomial. verdicts.title: Characterization of projective varieties beyond varieties of minimal degree and del Pezzo varieties
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
